01 / CONTEXT
BUSINESS REQUIREMENT

Free shipping when the subtotal after discounts is at least $100. Otherwise, shipping costs $10.

checkout.js−1 +1
  const discountedSubtotal = subtotal - discount;
− const shipping = discountedSubtotal >= 10000 ? 0 : 1000;
+ const shipping = subtotal >= 10000 ? 0 : 1000;
  return { shipping, total: discountedSubtotal + shipping };

Amounts in integer cents · No payments or external store involved

Your two-minute demo

“A green test suite only tells us the tests we wrote passed.”

  1. Run existing tests. Both versions pass. Nobody tested discounts.
  2. Find the gap. Read the requirement: eligibility is calculated after discounts. Be explicit about whether cases are prepared, imported, or generated live.
  3. Prove the regression. The same new tests pass on the correct build and expose the buggy build. Show the $110 − $20 example.
  4. Verify the fix. Switch to the corrected implementation. Rerun the unchanged tests and the original suite.

The bug is deliberately seeded. This prototype supports one checkout rule; it does not analyse arbitrary repositories or approve releases.
